name: using-git-worktrees

summary.en: Superpowers’ steps for creating an isolated git worktree before feature work so the main checkout stays clean.
summary.zh: Superpowers 的步骤：开发功能前先创建独立的 git worktree，让主工作区保持干净。

upstreamDescription: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
